subject: Win snapshots for sales deck: Aurelia Commerce
messages:
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Win snapshots for sales deck: Aurelia Commerce

Team —

We closed Aurelia last quarter and the account has strong metrics we should surface in the upcoming enterprise deck and one-pagers. Can we assemble a compact "win snapshot" package for sales enablement by EOD Friday (9/3)? Goal is a single-slide summary + a one-pager and 2 short quote cards we can drop into decks and case study pages.

Ask list:
- one-pager (logo, problem, solution, impact metrics) — Camila
- two short pull quotes (30–50 words) and named contact approval — Laura
- measurable metrics (latency improvements, $/token reduction, throughput gains) + source — Rishi

Camila: please attach your draft and I’ll start design pass. Laura: prioritize getting approval language and any NDA caveats. Rishi: include the metric collection query or link so we can cite it.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Win snapshots for sales deck: Aurelia Commerce

Thanks Mark — attaching a first-pass one-pager and two quote card mockups (see Aurelia_one-pager_v1.pdf and Aurelia_quote_card.png). Draft highlights:
- Problem: expensive inference for peak traffic
- Solution: Redwood Dedicated + prefix caching reduced average token latency across their search rerank pipeline
- Impact: 42% cost per 1M tokens reduction; 18% median latency improvement; now sustaining 1.2k TPS during flash loads

Quick questions: did we pin the metrics to the v3.2 rollout or to their mixed fleet baseline? Rishi, can you confirm the baseline and the exact timestamp we should reference?

Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Content Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aurelia_one-pager_v1.pdf, Aurelia_quote_card.png

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Win snapshots for sales deck: Aurelia Commerce

Nice draft, Camila — added two short quote candidates below (pull quotes we asked Jenna for):

Quote A (concise): "Redwood cut our inference cost by nearly half and kept response times steady during peak events — game changer for our ops team." — Jenna Torres, Head of Search, Aurelia Commerce

Quote B (metrics-forward): "After moving to Redwood Dedicated, our per-session inference cost dropped 42% and our P99 latency fell from 780ms to 320ms." — Jenna Torres, Head of Search, Aurelia Commerce

I also uploaded a Google Drive folder with the customer-approved performance dashboard exports. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Aurelia-Wins

Legal: we need a signed media release before publishing any named quotes. Markus — can you request approval and a simple release from Jenna? I can follow up with a redline if they push back.

—Laura

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Torres <jenna.torres@aurelia-commerce.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-04T10:16:00-07:00
Subject: Request: approval to use Aurelia quote and one-pager in Redwood sales materials

Hi Jenna — hope you’re well. I’m Markus on the Redwood enablement team; congrats again on your successful rollout. We put together a short one-pager and two quote cards to help our sales and CS teams talk about Aurelia’s results internally and with prospects. I’ve attached the draft one-pager and the quote card images.

Can you confirm you’re comfortable with the language below and sign the short media release if so? If you prefer a small edit to the wording, happy to adjust.

Draft quotes included for convenience:
- "Redwood cut our inference cost by nearly half and kept response times steady during peak events — game changer for our ops team."
- "After moving to Redwood Dedicated, our per-session inference cost dropped 42% and our P99 latency fell from 780ms to 320ms."

Attachments: Aurelia_one-pager_v1.pdf, Aurelia_quote_card.png

Thanks for considering. If you sign/ok the attached release we’ll publish the one-pager on our customer page and make the assets available to sales.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Torres <jenna.torres@aurelia-commerce.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, salesops@aurelia-commerce.com
Date: 2027-09-05T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval to use Aurelia quote and one-pager in Redwood sales materials

Hi Markus / Camila / Laura —

Thanks for sending these over. Happy to have Aurelia included. Small edit to Quote A: replace "game changer for our ops team" with "huge relief for our ops team" — otherwise the wording is fine. I attached a signed media release for your records (signed_media_release_Aurelia.pdf).

Feel free to publish the one-pager and use the quotes with the tiny edit. Please send over links when it goes live; we may amplify on our channels.

Best,
Jenna Torres
Head of Search, Aurelia Commerce

Attachment: signed_media_release_Aurelia.pdf
